analysis: The supplied units are BASE-side excerpts (lines 1619-2175) of CHANGELOG.md, a documentation-only file. The patch excerpt shows head changes only near lines 11-39: a new v0.10.10 candidate header and rollout notes describing `darkbloom waitlist` and account-level approval gates for new sandbox setups and new two-Mac cluster pairs. The base lines I examined are historical release notes and are unchanged by the patch. No code, protocol, key-handling, attestation, cache-storage or privilege path is modified in these units, so I identified no regression against the threat model (TB-002, TB-003, TB-007, TB-011, TB-012, TB-013, TB-014, T-041, T-059, T-061, T-062, etc.). The historical text mentions the SSD prefix cache (T-041) with 30-minute TTL, delta checkpoints, and maintenance changes, and the sandbox installer (TB-013/T-061). These are past entries, not new changes in this PR. Remaining integration questions are outside the supplied evidence. The truncated patch excerpt hides the rest of the waitlist description, and the actual waitlist implementation (coordinator-side approval, offline behavior of `darkbloom cluster local`, and fail-open or fail-closed behavior when the coordinator does not offer waitlists) is not visible. If other batches include code for the waitlist or sandbox gating, the next pass should check that the approval check cannot be bypassed in ways that matter to TB-013 (installer download/run as owner) and that no new unauthenticated network surface or credential disclosure is added. This unit gives no evidence of either.
